# Aurora Song's Rules
[color=red]The server rules are expected to be read in their entirety.[/color]
[color=red]All players must be 18+. All characters must be of physical and mental maturity for their species.[/color]
[color=red]To play various jobs, you are expected to have read their specific Standard Operating Procedures, and play a character who would be hired for that role reasonably.[/color]
[color=red]Attempts to evade job/role bans will result in a full ban.[/color]
[color=red]Rather than zero tolerance rules, it should be understood that these servers rules all stand to warn against, and prevent, activity that would result in admin action.[/color]
\n
##Community Guidelines
This server is about chaos, collaborative storytelling, actions, consequences, and fun. Done with mutual respect for each others time and enjoyment.
- [textlink="0. Admins have final say" link="ASRuleC0"]
- [textlink="1. Don't be a dick" link="ASRuleC1"]
- [textlink="2. Keep Aurora's Song a mature space" link="ASRuleC2"]
- [textlink="3. Respect consent, and accessibility statements" link="ASRuleC3"]
- [textlink="4. Keep information in character and in context" link="ASRuleC4"]
- 4.1 IC/OOC Conduct
- 4.2 Cloning and Revival
- [textlink="5. Do not 'powergame', exploit the game, use cheats, or macros" link="ASRuleC5"]
- [textlink="6. Aurora's song is an English language server" link="ASRuleC6"]
\n
##Roleplay Guidelines
Our roleplay guidelines are centered around ensuring good stories are available alongside players mechanical engagements.
- R1. Do not spam chat
- [textlink="R2. Follow proper naming conventions" link="ASRuleRP2"]
- [textlink="R3. Keep conversation in character, and be mindful of OC/LOOC chat" link="ASRuleRP3"]
- [textlink="R4. Avoid meta actions and netspeak" link="ASRuleRP4"]
\n
##Antagonism and Conflict
While the sandbox allows for crimes, antagonism, and conflict to be engaged with to serve the story and explore character traits, the following rules should be followed:
- [textlink="A1. Do not breach arrivals safe zone" link="ASRuleA1"]
- [textlink="A2. Follow proper escalation" link="ASRuleA2"]
- [textlink="A3. Keep criminal actions reasonable, and within consent and enjoyment of others" link="ASRuleA3"]
- [textlink="A4. Keep consent, and player status, in mind during shuttle boarding" link="ASRuleA4"]
- [textlink="A5. Crimes are not to be committed against SSD players" link="ASRuleA5"]
- [textlink="A6. Follow ghost role rules and proper antag behavior" link="ASRuleA6"]
\n
## Silicons and Law-Bound Entities
Law-bound entities must follow their laws to the letter, even if doing so would break Space Law. Detailed information below:
- [textlink="Silicons and Law-Bound Entities" link="ASRuleLawAndOrder"]
\n
## Aurora Sector Staff/SLE
The Staff of the sector, be they Security officers serving in the SLE, service staff on The Outpost, or some other role bankrolled by the government of the Aurora Sector, are to be an example of roleplay and conduct to the community. Some of these roles also have specific caveats to playing them that you implicitly agree to when taking the role.
- [textlink="Auroran Staff/SLE Standards" link="ASRuleStaff"]
- [textlink="Aurora Command Standards" link="ASRuleCommand"]
\n
## Erotic Roleplay (ERP) Rules
Engaging with ERP on our fork is allowed, and accommodated for via our consent options and rules in place. These rules are designed to ensure ERP is an avenue that player stories can explore, but not one that should be run into on accident, or without warning, by those who are not interested.
- Do not depict illegal content within the server, or discord.
- Ghost roles are forbidden from ERP
- If consent for a scene is not met, or withdrawn during a scene, the scene should end, and their exit from the scene must be accommodated.
- No "Harkness test", station crew/pets are not valid targets for scenes
- in line with rule C3. Consent, you shall not engage in ERP or adult scenes in public.
- PoI's are public spaces, and PB is especially off limits.
- The Alley, and the club located above its bar, is the exception to this rule (while still following basic rules for consent and warning players with privacy barriers or signs)
- Conversations in Ahelps are subject to consent rules. Provide content warnings prior to giving details, or wait for the admin to ask for details on the specific content warning before elaborating.
- Adult and erotic scenes have safeguards for players from interruption, using these safeguards to escape space law, or consequences is forbidden.
